meta.title: FieldShift Node v1 — Bill of Materials
meta.disclaimer: All unit costs are indicative, pilot-quantity engineering estimates (order of ~100-300 units) for planning purposes only. They are NOT quotes from any supplier and will move with FX rates, freight, and local import duty.
meta.fx_note: Indicative FX used throughout this page: 1 USD = 15,800 IDR (Sept 2026 planning rate).

device_parts.name: 6 V 2 W Polycrystalline Solar Panel
device_parts.why: Sized so a fraction of a tropical day's insolation fully recharges the pack even after mounting-angle, dust, and controller losses, keeping the node net-energy-positive on all but extended monsoon overcast.

device_parts.name: IP65 Enclosure Lid

spec.Feature: Clear inspection window over status LED

device_parts.why: UV-stabilised plastic and a sealed lid keep tropical sun and wind-driven rain out of the electronics bay without needing a metal housing, which would add cost and corrosion risk in humid, saline coastal soils.

device_parts.name: IP65 Enclosure Base
device_parts.why: Carries the stake bracket and the single M12 cable entry, so there is exactly one sealed penetration to maintain in the field rather than several.

device_parts.name: Main PCB — ESP32-S3 + SX1262 LoRa

spec.Interfaces: SDI-12, I2C, ADC, GPIO relay driver

device_parts.why: ESP32-S3 gives enough headroom to run sensor sampling and the local safety rules even when the LoRa link is down; SX1262 on AS923 is the correct regional radio band and duty-cycle profile for Indonesia.

device_parts.name: 18650 Li-ion Cell (2x)

spec.Capacity: 3400 mAh per cell (2x in parallel = 6,800 mAh pack)

device_parts.why: Two cells in parallel double runtime for a small cost step and let the pack keep the valve-actuation current spikes from sagging the rail, while staying inside a form factor that fits the sealed enclosure.

device_parts.name: AS923 Whip + Helical Antenna

spec.Type: Whip monopole with helical loading coil

device_parts.why: External helical antenna clears the enclosure and canopy for a cleaner line of sight to the gateway than a PCB trace antenna could give at this radio budget.

device_parts.name: M12 IP68 Cable Gland

spec.Purpose: Strain relief where the sensor cable exits the base

device_parts.why: The single most common field failure on buried-sensor IoT nodes is water tracking in along the cable; a proper IP68 gland with strain relief removes that failure mode for a little over a dollar.

device_parts.name: Shielded Sensor Cable

spec.Length: ~0.6 m to 15 cm probe, ~1.0 m to 40 cm probe
spec.Protection: Potted at both ends against moisture ingress

device_parts.why: Direct-burial-rated cable with potted ends survives being backfilled with wet soil for multiple growing seasons without the SDI-12 signal degrading.

device_parts.name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Probe — 15 cm
device_parts.why: Capacitive sensing avoids the electrode corrosion that kills resistive gypsum-block probes within a season in wet tropical soils; the shallow depth tracks the fast-draining feeder-root zone the irrigation rule reacts to first.

device_parts.name: Capacitive Soil Moisture Probe — 40 cm
device_parts.why: A second, deeper probe distinguishes a genuinely dry root zone from a surface that has simply dried between waterings, which is what keeps the closed-loop rule from over-irrigating.

device_parts.name: Galvanized Mounting Stake

spec.Purpose: Anchors the enclosure above canopy height

device_parts.why: Keeps the electronics and antenna above the crop canopy for both sun exposure and radio line-of-sight, and above casual contact from livestock or field tools.

device_parts.name: Soil Cross-Section (visualization only)

spec.Role: Visualization aid, not a purchased part
spec.Represents: Native soil profile around the probes

device_parts.why: Included in the 3D model purely so probe depth relative to the root zone is legible; it is not a bill-of-materials line item.

device_parts.name: SHT31 Air Temperature / Humidity Sensor

spec.Mount: Vented, conformal-coated boss in the lid

device_parts.why: Cheap microclimate read that lets the decision layer flag heat/humidity stress independently of soil moisture; mounted on the main PCB, shown as one of the small chip volumes in the 3D model.

device_parts.name: Solar Li-ion Charge Controller

spec.Type: CN3791 MPPT (or TP4056 linear) charge controller

device_parts.why: Protects the pack across a multi-year unattended deployment and gets more usable energy out of a very small 2 W panel than a bare linear charger would; mounted on the main PCB.

gateway_actuation_parts.name: 12 V DC Solenoid Valve
gateway_actuation_parts.why: Normally-closed construction means any power loss, wiring fault, or controller crash defaults the line shut — matching the guardrail that irrigation must fail closed, never open.

gateway_actuation_parts.name: Opto-isolated Relay / Driver Board

spec.Control: GPIO signal from the node/gateway controller

gateway_actuation_parts.why: Opto-isolation keeps a shorted valve coil or miswired 12 V line from taking out the low-voltage logic side of the gateway.

gateway_actuation_parts.name: Hall-Effect Water Flow Meter

spec.Output: Pulse frequency proportional to flow rate
spec.Purpose: Confirms real flow during the Verify step

gateway_actuation_parts.why: Without a flow read, an open command and an actually-open valve are only assumed to be the same thing; this is what feeds the no-flow alert guardrail.
